description: ADR secures enterprise AI agents through observability, security benchmarking, and threat detection. Deployed at Uber.

summary.one_liner: ADR is an open-source enterprise security system for AI agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and others) covering endpoint discovery, telemetry sensing, a security benchmark, and threat detection, and is stated to be deployed in production at Uber.
summary.what_it_does: The repository contains four open-source components: ADR Discovery, which inventories AI apps, CLI agents, IDE extensions, local model runtimes and MCP servers on an endpoint and flags unknown surfaces; ADR Sensor, which collects and normalizes agent telemetry from tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI, DeepSeek Harness, opencode and Claude Desktop, including Gemini CLI session journals; ADR-Bench (in Detection/), with 304 benchmark tasks and 134 MCP servers; and ADR Detector, a dual-agent detector with a high-recall triage tier and a deeper reasoning tier. The README says the prevention component and the offline ADR Explorer red-teaming engine are not included in this release. Detection/ includes synthetic fixtures (fake credentials, emulated environments, prompt-injection scenarios) intended for defensive research only.
use_cases: inventory unsanctioned AI tools on employee laptops
monitor what coding agents do on endpoints
benchmark AI agent security against prompt injection
detect risky behavior in agent sessions
reproduce paper benchmark and detection results
how_to_run: git clone the repository (URL left blank in README)
For keyless smoke tests use --detector llamafirewall (see Detection/README.md)
Follow docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md to inflate the packed benchmark, run detectors, and plot figures
notable: Deployed in production at Uber, per the README, and accepted to MLSys 2026
Covers Discovery, Observability, Benchmark, and Detection as separate components with a documented layout
ADR-Bench includes 304 tasks, 134 MCP servers, and 17 agent attack techniques
Two-tier detector pairing high-recall triage with deeper agentic reasoning
Cross-platform telemetry claims for macOS, Linux and Windows
caveats: Prevention component and offline ADR Explorer red-teaming engine are not in the open-source release
Quick start requires Anthropic and OpenAI API keys for the default detector; a keyless option exists only for smoke tests
Clone URL is blank in the README, so the exact repository address must be taken from GitHub
